notes.title: Small patch (1.3.4)
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Updates to Brazilian Portuguese localization
- Bugfix: Settings menu scroll position no longer resets on mouse leave
- Bugfix: Bounding rectangle for "Reset settings"-button now correctly scales to cover text area (German, French, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese)

notes.title: 1.3.2.4 - Localization hotfix
notes.content:
Just a quick hotfix addressing missing dialogue bugs in the latest batch of localized languages.
The dialogue for the affected items would revert to Turkish. As far as I can tell this affected certain context-dependent items, so not everyone would have encountered them on a playthrough. Apologies to anyone who did!

notes.title: 1.3.2 - More language support
notes.content:
Glad to be able to bring wider language support to That Which Gave Chase. This update adds support for:

- Simplified Chinese
- Traditional Chinese
- French
- German
- European Spanish
- Latin American Spanish

Thanks to the following for their work on this update:
- Pulse Translation (Translation Lead)
- Mimir Translations (German)
- Esther C. (French)
- Bláth Mór (Spanish)
- Loyuli (Traditional Chinese)
- Albert Chen (Simplified Chinese)

notes.title: 1.3.1 - Turkish localization, performance improvements, ++
notes.content:
It's October, winter is at the gate, time for another update for That Which Gave Chase.

Now available in Turkish! Big thanks to [url=https://x.com/elektrikmavi]mavi[/url] for her wonderful work on this translation.

This update also includes various bugfixes and improvements, including several improvements addressing performance issues.

[list]
[*] Minor UI improvements related to localization.
[*] New text font, improving readability and consistency across language versions.
[*] Performance improvements: Optimized tree LODs. Fixed rendering bug. Optimized terrain in larger areas.
[*] Other bugfixes:
[list]
		[*] Fixed issue where the game could fail to complete respawn if player dies while a dialogue asset is being loaded (hotfix 1.3.0.1)
		[*] Fixed issue with center dot sometimes remaining visible after interacting with a readable object
		[*] Interaction icons no longer overlay interact text.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Small hotfix (Version 1.3.0.1)
notes.content:
Small hotfix while a larger patch is in testing.

This fix addresses an issue introduced by the last update: the game no longer fails to automatically reload a scene if dialogue is triggered while a scene reload is in progress (e.g. after the player has died).

notes.title: Japanese localization! 1-year anniversary! Summer sale! (Version 1.3.0)
notes.content:
That Which Gave Chase is one year old. Time flies? Or slithers along at a glacial pace? Somehow both at once. Regardless, I'm glad to be able to celebrate the 1-year anniversary by rolling out localization support, starting with a wonderful Japanese translation courtesy of translator Youge.

When starting the game for the first time after applying this update, it should default to Japanese if Steam is set to run in Japanese. You can also set the language under properties in Steam, or change language in-game from the main menu settings view.

This update also introduces some improvements and accessibility features, including:
- option to increase dialogue text duration
- text color and background options
- option to enable sound feedback when new dialogue plays
- minor UI bugfixes

notes.title: Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
- Adds a scene selection feature, which can be accessed from the main menu. Scenes will unlock as you play through the game, allowing you to go back and replay parts as you please.
If you have any existing checkpoint data upon launching the game after this update, the game will use this to unlock relevant scenes.

- Tweaks difficulty in the game's final section.

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 (July 10, 2023)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adds Vsync support. Three options, off, on (refresh rate) and on (half refresh rate) are now accessible through the settings menu.
[*] Aims to fix a difficult to reproduce bug where the end section of the map would fail to spawn (ice scene).
[*] Improved lighting in darker scenes.
[*] Fixes a bug with the navmesh in first cabin scene, causing the scientist to clip with the environment in certain areas.
[/list]
